name: FlappyBird CE
summary: Tap to keep the bird up and the pipes coming.
description:
Flappy Bird for the CE. Press any key to start and to flap; every key is the same key, which is the whole game.

[clear] leaves.
author: Ricovl

uninstall.text: Your saved game is in an appvar called FLAPPYB, which the game made itself. It has exactly the name of the program this has just removed and is a different variable for all that -- look under AppVars rather than Prgm. It has been left alone, so reinstalling picks up where you stopped. Delete it by hand from [2nd] [+], 2:Mem Mgmt/Del, B:AppVars if you would rather start over.
